evidence.MCL: MCL:  Mild thickening, consistent with chronic sprain.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Oblique tear of the posterior medial meniscus with inferior articular surfacing.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: The lateral meniscus is peripherally extruded and macerated, consistent with extensive complex degenerative tear.
evidence.Medial OA: Medial compartment articular cartilage:  Grade 2 chondrosis with mild degenerative changes, including osteophyte formation.
evidence.Lateral OA: Lateral compartment articular cartilage:  Grade 4 chondrosis with complete denuding of the articular surface and extensive degenerative changes
evidence.PF OA: Patellofemoral cartilage:  Grade 1 chondrosis with mild degenerative changes.
evidence.Effusion: Joint effusion:  Small volume effusion mostly in the suprapatellar recess.
evidence.Contusion: Subchondral edema involving the lateral tibial plateau and lateral femoral condyle.
evidence.Fracture: The lateral compartment is completely attenuated with bone-on-bone articulation and extensive degenerative changes.
